## FinPlan Pro 5 UNIQUE Moats

1. **Offline-First** — No competitor works offline. We do (Tauri + IndexedDB)
2. **Desktop App** — No competitor has native desktop. We do (Tauri)
3. **Plugin System** — No competitor has extensibility. We do (7 files, 1585 lines)
4. **Accessibility** — No competitor is WCAG compliant. We are (7 components)
5. **Keyboard Shortcuts** — No competitor has keyboard nav. We do (full system)
